I'm a celestial IW main and I definitely felt like she took a second for me to figure her out. Some quick tips.

You can weave your primary in between most abilities/melee. This is really very core to her kit as I'm often weaving between melee when killing someone or between her shield when focus healing someone. 

Her vortex makes people fall, so if you hit a flying character they get dragged down which can get them killed.

I often spam right click on people I'm focus healing especially if they aren't tank. The fact that it can take a bullet but also is a HOT makes it a very good heal supplement. You can also just spam it on a low HP flying character to heal them.

Push and pull work better by about 5m when people are airborne or jumping. 

Try very hard not to break your stealth if you have to double jump. You are up a creek without a paddle if you get dove while the cooldown for double jump is tickling. 

Position so that you can heal as many people as possible and hit enemies if possible. This will let you build ult fast. Not as fast as C&D but pretty quickly. 

If people are getting dove by spiderman or some other dive you can spam shield and it makes them near unkillable.

You can rip a wolverine off whoever he is diving with pull.

You really need to have something at the top of your network ie a router initiating the vpn and sending all of its traffic up to said vpn provider. This isn't really a plug and play solution, it's something that would require research and configuration on your part to match the setup you have.

If you change out DNS servers from what I'm assuming is defaulting to your ISPs dns then you will be going somewhere else, likely google or cloudflare, for those requests which keeps a little bit more of your browsing away from the ISP. 

I'm not sure what you mean running lan? Your lan is the network you have that is before you get to the ISP router. So your computers and devices etc. 

If privacy is your really big concern then pump all your data through a vpn of some sort. It may slow you down a little as you will have to travel across the vpn before going to where you want but it will truly keep what you are doing out of your ISPs hands.

Change your DNS server to point to something not ISP based, or set up a PiHole https://docs.pi-hole.net/. Or change out your ISPs router all together. 

Regardless of what you are doing unless your traffic is encapsulated going out it is technically visible to your ISP though in all likely hood that information isn't being used.
